MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

2. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 0

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 19

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

   A. 4

   C. 40
   D. 10

   A. 10

   D. 122

   A. 170

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14

11. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2

   D. 14

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. C — 64
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 8
3. Product = 64
Final Answer: 64
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer

Working:
